testimonial.title: Hi, I'm Luiz Brazão 👋
paragraphs: I spent years leading teams in big, small, and medium-sized companies — some with names you'd recognize, and others you wouldn't.

And you know what? I kept hitting the same wall:
it wasn't a lack of brilliant people. It was a lack of clarity about what the company actually had on its plate.

Apps no one knew were still in use, integrations someone patched by hand every week, decisions getting remade like a weekly déjà vu.
For a while, just tidying things up was enough.
Not anymore.

Because the market moves fast.
And if you try to layer AI on top of a stack nobody controls, the only thing that scales is the chaos.

That's why IA Operators exists: to diagnose the technology stack of mid-sized companies, prioritize what really moves the needle, and build the solutions — with no hand-offs between who thinks and who executes.
With AI. But no smoke and mirrors.

Because AI isn't magic — it's strategy.
And before you automate, someone needs to know exactly what's on the table.

items.q: What does IA Operators actually do?
items.a: We audit the technology stack of mid-sized companies (50–500 people), prioritize what to solve first, and build the solutions — AI automations, API integrations, and custom systems. We diagnose and execute. No hand-offs.

items.q: How are you different from a consultancy or an AI agency?
items.a: Consultancies deliver slide decks and disappear; AI agencies build whatever you ask without prior diagnostics. We're the same team that maps the real problem and then builds it.

Our entry-level service: we map every application, license, integration, dependency, and Shadow IT in your company. Deliverables: master inventory, license matrix, integration map, risk analysis, and an executive report with prioritized recommendations.

Companies of 50–500 people that have grown by accumulating tools without a planned architecture. Sectors: hospitality, healthcare, professional services, retail, real estate, mid-market manufacturing.

items.q: How much does the Digital X-Ray cost?
items.a: From €4,500 + VAT, fixed-scope 3-week project. Includes inventory, integration map, risk analysis, and prioritized recommendations.

items.q: What if we want to execute after the audit?
items.a: It's the usual path. The audit leads into a Technology Roadmap (4–6 weeks) and/or Implementation: automations, integrations, and custom systems. Fixed-scope projects or monthly retainer.

items.q: Will you touch the infrastructure we already have?
items.a: We don't break what works. We document first, integrate after. Recommendations are always prioritized by impact vs. risk.
A 30-minute call to understand the context. If there's a fit, we send a fixed-scope Digital X-Ray proposal.
